name: Chase Off Creep
steps: Tap mirror to blind the driver.
Tap bus window to reveal ugly passenger.
Tap ad banner to show anime girl distraction.
Tap banana peel to make car slip.
Tap rooftop model to distract him.
Tap storage panel to release guard dog.
Tap exhaust to blow bad smoke into car.
Tap streetlamp/sign to drop object on him.
Tap phone to call his angry wife.
Tap police officer to arrest and remove him.
